svg.title: GPU-to-GPU communication paths
svg.desc: Comparison of a direct NVLink and NVSwitch path with a slower host-staged PCIe fallback through CPU memory.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: The selected physical path sets the communication ceiling
High bandwidth • low latency • no CPU copy
Extra copies add latency and consume bandwidth
Always verify the actual NCCL path — GPU numbering does not describe topology.
